bot.clear: This chat starts over. Its next message opens a new conversation in Astra, with no memory of the last one — and every other chat is left where it was.
bot.new_created: Opened a new conversation in a chat of its own — open it and write there. A bot cannot take you to it: Telegram has no way to move anybody's view.
bot.new_failed: Telegram would not open a topic just now. Try again in a moment, or use /clear to start this chat over where it is.
bot.new_here: Telegram will not open a second chat here: this bot has no topic mode in private chats, and that is a setting of the bot itself (@BotFather), not of this chat. So this chat starts over instead — its next message begins a new conversation, with no memory of the last one.
bot.new_opened: New conversation. Write here — the first message becomes this topic's name, the same name the conversation gets in Astra.
bot.new_refused: I cannot open a chat here. This group needs Topics turned on, and the bot has to be an administrator in it with "Manage topics". Or use /clear to start this chat over where it is.
bot.not_permitted: Astra did not allow this plugin to send a message. Grant it "Send a chat message" in the plugin's settings.
bot.screenshot_failed: The screen could not be captured. The plugin log has the reason.
bot.screenshot_off: /screenshot is switched off. Turn on "Allow /screenshot" in the plugin's settings — it sends a picture of this machine's screen into this chat, so read what it says there first.
bot.screenshot_unsupported: /screenshot works on Windows only. This build of the plugin carries no screen capture, so there is nothing to switch on here — the rest of the bot is unaffected.
bot.send_failed: Astra could not answer. The plugin log has the reason.
bot.start:
Astra Telegram Bot is active.

Send any message and it goes to Astra; the reply appears here as it is written.

Every chat has its own conversation in Astra, with its own memory — this one, any group, and each topic separately.

/new — a new conversation in a chat of its own, where Telegram allows one: a bot with topic mode on, or a forum group. Anywhere else it starts this chat over
/clear — start this chat's conversation over, right here
/screenshot — send a picture of the screen, if it has been switched on in settings
/stop — stop the reply being written; in a private chat the message has a Stop button of its own
/help — this message
Telegram's own New chat button does the same and takes you straight there — a chat opened that way is named by its first message too.
config.allow_screenshot.description: Let /screenshot send a picture of this machine's screen into the Telegram chat. Windows only: on other systems the command says so and nothing else changes. Off by default: everything else the bot does is a conversation with an AI, and this is a live view of the desktop. Set Allowed Usernames before turning it on.

config.allowed_usernames.description: Comma-separated Telegram usernames (without @) allowed to use the bot, in any chat. Leave it empty and the bot answers one account only: the first that talks to it, wherever they write — and nobody else, in any chat.
